_about: SERIES SHELF: The German Classics of the Nineteenth and Twentieth Centuries: Masterpieces of German Literature Translated into English, edited by Kuno Francke with William Guild Howard (German Publication Society, New York, 1913-1914), all 20 volumes, from Goethe and Schiller to Hauptmann, Thomas Mann, Schnitzler and Wedekind. Each volume names its many translators on a contributors page; the gate checks the editor-in-chief's name, or one of that volume's translators where the OCR does not keep his legibly. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 94); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Kuno Francke, the editor-in-chief, where the OCR keeps his name; otherwise one translator named on that volume's contributors page. 'francke' alone is left out because it would collide with the august-hermann-francke shelf.
_surname_note: Per volume: the editor-in-chief or one named translator.

_excluded.lyon-albany-printing: The J. B. Lyon (Albany) printing of the series, which styles Francke 'Emeritus', is undated; the German Publication Society's 1913-1914 printing is used for all 20 volumes.

gcl-vol-07.post_1930_examined: Examined in round 94: 2024 is the Internet Archive digitising note ('Digitized by the Internet Archive in 2024'), not an imprint.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
